title: OpenExpert local configuration
description: Schema for the openexpert.json file consumed by the OpenExpert local edition. Environment variables OPENEXPERT_* always take precedence over the file.

mode.description: Edition to start. `local` runs on your machine; `cloud` uses Supabase + Vercel.

modelProvider.description: Which model provider the chat should use.

modelId.description: Identifier of the model as known by the chosen provider.

ollamaBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the Ollama server (OpenAI-compatible endpoint).

dataDir.description: Directory where local mode stores data files. `~/` expands to the user's home directory.
